text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju (Persimpangan

Bertingkat Kajang Utama) 2016.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 10 Mac 2016.

Larangan

2. (1) Pemanduan suatu kenderaan motor dengan kelajuan yang melebihi had

laju yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) Jadual Pertama di atas jalan yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama adalah dilarang.

(2) Jalan dengan had laju yang dinyatakan di bawah subperenggan (1)

ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual Kedua.

JADUAL PERTAMA

(1)

Jalan

(2)

Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Persimpangan Bertingkat

Kajang Utama, Lebuh Raya Penyuraian Trafik Lingkaran Kajang

yang bermula dari kilometer 20.20 di koordinat U 10797.085,

T 21754.686 Grid Cassini Negeri Selangor dan berakhir di kilometer

20.80 di koordinat U 10412.907, T 21770.802 Grid Cassini Negeri

Selangor.

DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Menteri Kerja Raya

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

SPEED LIMIT (KAJANG UTAMA INTERCHANGE) ORDER 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(2) of the

Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes of the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Speed Limit (Kajang Utama

Interchange) Order 2016.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 10 March 2016.

Prohibition

2. (1) The driving of a motor vehicle at a speed exceeding the speed limit

specified in column (2) of the First Schedule on the road specified in column (1) of the

First Schedule is prohibited.

(2) The road with speed limit as specified under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Second Schedule.

 FIRST SCHEDULE

(1)

Road

(2)

Speed limit

(km/j)

The part of the road known as the Kajang Utama Interchange, Kajang

Traffic Dispersal Ring Road which commence from kilometer 20.20

at coordinate N 10797.085, E 21754.686 of Selangor State Cassini

Grid and ending at kilometre 20.80 at coordinate N 10412.907, E

21770.802 of Selangor State Cassini Grid.
